subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Bantan Sango Detective Agency

190603701.text: "I murdered Takatsukasa Isamu. I poisoned his cold medicine."

190603702.text: "Though he appeared to be honest and honorable in public, in secret, he asked me to search out a new type of poison to get rid of those who opposed him."

190603703.text: "He also said that if I refused, he would have me thrown in prison. He used my family to blackmail me."

190603704.text: "He left me with no choice. I killed him with a new type of poison that I had someone purchase for me at the International Trade Association... To protect myself, I later framed my colleague Ryuuji."

190603705.text: "But now it's only a matter of time before the detective uncovers everything. I know that I've made a big mistake, and that there's no escaping it now. Only death awaits me. I merely ask that my family be spared."

190603706.text: Hey, this is the key to proving that Shiroyama was the murderer, right? That is, if he was telling the truth, of course.

190603401.text: The suspect, Shiroyama, 22 years old, forensic doctor, a subordinate of the deceased, Takatsukasa Isamu.

190603402.text: Shiroyama grew to resent his boss, Takatsukasa Isamu, following conflict at work. He then secretly bought a bottle of poison to kill him in revenge.

190603403.text: Unused poison was later found in the suspect Shiroyama's office. In his testament, he confessed to having planted the poison found in Ryuuji's house.

190603404.text: For the crime of premeditated murder, Shiroyama is hereby sentenced to death. Punishment cannot be carried out as the suspect ended his own life before the execution could take place. This file shall be kept as evidence.

190603406.text: Huh? So Shiroyama's conviction was also signed by Kujou Sara... just like Ryuuji's!

190603201.speakerName: The Autopsy Report of Takatsukasa Isamu
190603201.text: The deceased, Takatsukasa Isamu, 41 years old, Police Station manager.

190603202.speakerName: The Autopsy Report of Takatsukasa Isamu
190603202.text: Clothes intact at time of death. No visible trauma observed on the body, no sign of a struggle. The throat was congested and swollen, caused by a cold before his death.

190603203.speakerName: The Autopsy Report of Takatsukasa Isamu
190603203.text: Local ulceration was found in the stomach and intestines, caused by a novel toxin found in the stomach contents. Stomach contents include: partially undigested soft rice residue; ...

190603204.speakerName: The Autopsy Report of Takatsukasa Isamu
190603204.text: ...small volume of fish-liver paste residue, the main ingredient of which is highly-concentrated fish-liver extract, a valuable nutritional supplement; ...

190603205.speakerName: The Autopsy Report of Takatsukasa Isamu
190603205.text: ...small volume of cold medicine residue containing a large amount of acidic fruit and vegetable extracts. Appears to be a specially prepared medicine from the Office of Forensic Science; ...

190603206.speakerName: The Autopsy Report of Takatsukasa Isamu
190603206.text: ...small volume of novel toxin residue, which was found to be the same toxin discovered in the homes of Ryuuji and Shiroyama. Cause of death: abdominal mucous membrane disease plus respiratory and circulatory failure triggered by the novel toxin.

190603207.text: Yikes... he ate all kinds of stuff!

190603301.text: The suspect, Ryuuji, 20 years old, Doushin, a subordinate of the deceased, Takatsukasa Isamu.

190603302.text: Ryuuji grew to resent his boss, Takatsukasa Isamu, following conflict at work. He then secretly bought a bottle of poison to kill him in revenge.

190603303.text: Unused poison was later found in the suspect Ryuuji's house. For the crime of premeditated murder, Ryuuji is ordered to remain in temporary incarceration awaiting trial. This file shall be kept as evidence.

190603305.text: Wow, Ryuuji's conviction really was signed by Kujou Sara... But now we know she had it wrong.

190603501.text: On the toxin that caused Takatsukasa Isamu's death:

190603502.text: An odorless, tasteless, and inert substance. Soluble in water, but insoluble in other substances. Has the properties of a synthetic toxin. It appears as a fine, white, powdery substance in its normal state. Tentative name: "white powder."

190603503.text: The station has investigated the ledgers of all domestic commerce guilds, no transaction record for such an item was found.

190603504.text: Hmm, a synthetic toxin? What's that?

190603601.text: "A week before the incident, Master Takatsukasa Isamu caught a cold and lost his appetite. Rice was all he could eat and he had been taking some special cold medicine."

190603602.text: "The night before the incident, he had yet to recover and was still busy with his work, so I was worried about his health. When Dr. Shiroyama came to deliver the medicine, I consulted him about a health supplement."

190603603.text: "Dr. Shiroyama said fish-liver paste could help boost his immune system, so I went to the forensic office to retrieve some and gave it to Master Takatsukasa..."

190603604.text: "But by the next day... Really, Master Takatsukasa was so kind to me, I swear I wouldn't ever do that to him!"

190603605.text: Hmm, come to think of it, Shiroyama was a forensic doctor... He could easily pull off something like this.

190603801.speakerName: Research Log from the Office of Forensic Science
190603801.text: (It's blank. Looks like someone tore out a few pages.)

190603802.text: Eh? That's weird, there's nothing here! This must be some of the false information that Heizou told us to look out for.

190603901.text: A note placed with Shiroyama's Testament. After comparing the handwriting, it was confirmed to have been written by the deceased, Takatsukasa Isamu.

190603902.text: "Shiroyama, long time no see. I trust the thing I asked you for is in progress?"

190603903.text: "I paid a visit to your home today while you weren't around. Thankfully, your wonderful wife welcomed me in... She's a fine woman. A perfect match for you."

190603904.text: "Your wife is five months pregnant, I believe? Fancy that — my wife too."

190603905.text: "I took the liberty of returning once more to provide her with some health supplements, even helped administer them to her myself. She was most grateful indeed."

190603906.text: "You will be equally grateful to me, no doubt? Then don't keep me waiting."

190603907.text: Takatsukasa Isamu seems like a thoughtful person, but something about the tone sounds weird...

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for Ryuuji at Netsuke no Gen Crafts

190602901.text: Traveler, I believe you can find out the truth. That Shikanoin is hiding something, I just know it.

190602902.text: *sigh*... Sango and Detective Heizou are both great people, but when they're together, only arguing ensues.

190603001.text: Hey, Traveler. Investigating a case isn't so easy, is it? Don't worry, I'll tell you all you need to know.

190603003.text: Hah, Sango? The Takatsukasa Clan really hired an amazing detective, didn't they?

190603004.text: She comes to the station to submit applications every now and then, and has been constantly requesting to reinvestigate the Ryuuji Case. But Heizou has always prevented her from doing so. I really didn't expect that she'd go as far as writing a complaint letter, though. Whew, she's relentless.

190603005.text: As for why Heizou senpai has been keeping her away from the case, I think he's afraid that Sango would be putting herself in danger. After all, we're talking about the murder of an important man, that can be deep water if you're not careful...

190603006.text: Sango may run a detective agency, but in the end, she's just an ordinary person.

190603008.text: Uh well... not exactly. I've pretty much seen them argue every time they meet. But, Heizou might still consider her as an old friend. I heard that he used to work with Sango.

190603009.text: Sometimes he'd ask me to hand over less pressing cases to the detective agency. I guess he just wants to support Sango's business.

190603010.text: Hehe, Heizou senpai is a good person, there's no doubt about that.

190603101.text: Don't take anything Uesugi says too seriously. Just nod along...

190603103.text: Oh, that? Well, let me see...

190603104.text: Ryuuji saw Takatsukasa Isamu as his foster father, that's for sure. But I can't say whether Isamu helped Ryuuji without expecting anything in return.

190603105.text: After all, Isamu was a resourceful person. A simple and naive person like Ryuuji wouldn't ever be suitable as an adviser, but he could certainly be a loyal and trustworthy aid.

190603106.text: Isamu was expecting a child of his own later, but unfortunately he was killed before the child was ever born...

190603107.text: Anyway, enough about all that... Aren't you here to investigate the case? You'd better get a move on.

190604101.text: I am at a loss for words right now... please, just leave me be.

190604201.text: Wait, aren't you going to see Ryuuji?

190604202.text: What did Heizou say to you when he left the agency?

190604203.text: Hah, now that I think about it, it's like a slap in the face...

190604204.text: He said, "Some things will always be more important than the truth."
